comment: SEC-44 vendor allowlist. Only vendors reviewed in docs/research/VENDORS.md (R0, SAFE) or first-party APIs ship here. A profile's base URL host must be in its vendor's hosts; users may add only loopback local profiles. Adding a vendor needs a VENDORS.md review first.

vendors.label: Anthropic API
vendors.note: First-party. The user's own Anthropic API key, billed per token.

vendors.label: OpenAI API
vendors.note: First-party. The user's own OpenAI API key, for Codex.

vendors.label: OpenRouter
vendors.note: VENDORS.md §2.5: SAFE for the Anthropic protocol with paid models. Its Responses API is beta (REVIEW), and :free models are REVIEW.

vendors.label: Fireworks AI
vendors.note: VENDORS.md §2.8: SAFE for the Anthropic protocol (Bearer auth). Model ids are accounts/fireworks/models/..., so set the tier models. Responses stores data by default (REVIEW).

vendors.label: Ollama (this machine)
vendors.note: VENDORS.md §3: v0.14.0+ for Claude Code, v0.13.3+ for Codex. A preset only; any loopback URL is allowed for local profiles.

vendors.label: LM Studio (this machine)
vendors.note: VENDORS.md §3: 0.4.1+ for Claude Code, 0.3.29+ for Codex. A preset only.
